title.narrative: Supporting the Capacity of Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) in Disaster Risk Managemen

description.narrative: The call for proposal aims increasing institutional and technical capacities of CSOs active in disaster risk management. It will target CSOs specialised in the field of disaster risk management as well as organisations working in other fields such as gender equality, children rights, nature protection, refugee rights and others aiming to support citizens and business community with initiatives to improve disaster risk management.
